request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change only two things: the dark leather flying cap becomes a dented rusted iron pot helmet with bolts, keeping the goggles on its front, and his skin (face, both ears, hands, feet) becomes a much brighter, lighter yellow-olive green. Keep everything else exactly the same: the dark leather clothes and patch, the bomb with its yellow stripes and spark, the satchel, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
